definitions.explanation: Showing original thinking or creativity; not derived from or imitating others.

examples.japanese: {彼|かれ}の{作品|さくひん}は{非常|ひじょう}に{独創的|どくそうてき}だ。
{独創的|どくそうてき}なアイデアを{出|だ}すのが{彼女|かのじょ}の{強|つよ}みだ。
examples.english: Coming up with creative ideas is her strength.

examples.japanese: この{建築|けんちく}は{独創的|どくそうてき}なデザインで{知|し}られている。
examples.english: This architecture is known for its original design.

notes:
FORMS:
・Adverbial: {独創的|どくそうてき}に (originally, creatively)
・Noun: {独創|どくそう} (originality), {独創性|どくそうせい} (creativity)

COMMON PATTERNS:
・{独創的|どくそうてき}な{発想|はっそう} (original idea/concept)
・{独創的|どくそうてき}な{作品|さくひん} (original work)
・{独創的|どくそうてき}なアプローチ (creative approach)

CONTRAST:
・{独創的|どくそうてき}: emphasizes originality and unique creation
・{創造的|そうぞうてき}: emphasizes the creative process
・{革新的|かくしんてき}: emphasizes innovation and breaking new ground
